repo.description:
### Impact

When an authenticated user goes to renew an OpenBao token issued by the Kubernetes Auth method, the Kubernetes Auth method did not properly validate that the service account token which was originally used to perform authentication was still valid. This allowed an attacker to persist access after the service account was deleted.

This vulnerability is original to HashiCorp Vault.

### Patch

This vulnerability is patched in OpenBao v2.7.1 and v2.6.4.
repo.summary: OpenBao's Kubernetes Auth Method Allows Renewal on Revoked Tokens
